## Problem and result / 问题与结果

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. Link related issues when available.
说明触发场景和修改后的结果，关联相关 Issue（如有）。

## Verification / 验证

List commands and actual results; include synthetic screenshots for UI changes.
列出执行命令和实际结果；界面变化附合成数据截图。仅文档修改说明链接、事实与双语检查结果。

## Documentation / 文档

- [ ] Updated affected README and feature-page language pairs together, including limits; or explained why no update is needed.
      同步更新受影响的中英文 README、特性说明和限制，或说明不需更新的原因。
- [ ] Added a bilingual CHANGELOG entry for user-facing or documentation changes.
      为用户可见变化或文档变化补充双语 CHANGELOG 条目。
- [ ] For a release PR, completed [the release documentation checklist](https://github.com/sdzcgaoxiang/OhMyNewTabTodo/blob/codex/local-v1/docs/releasing.md) and recorded non-applicable items; otherwise marked this PR as not a release.
      发布 PR 完成文档清单并说明不适用项；其他 PR 注明并非版本发布。
- [ ] No real exports, browser profiles, credentials, or proprietary original code/assets are included.
      未包含真实导出、浏览器配置、凭据或原插件闭源代码/素材。
